subject: Activity ledger / admin event evidence — export format & attested manifest request
messages:
From: Patricia Gomez <audit@novamed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: NovaMed Compliance <compliance@novamed.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: admin activity evidence and export options for SOC 2 audit

Hi Soojin,

We're kicking off the SOC 2 Type II evidence collection for the period 2027-06-01 to 2027-12-31. To scope the request we need the following clearly enumerated and exportable:

- A catalog of "admin activity" event types Redwood records (auths, role changes, key rotations, operator actions, etc.).
- Exact fields captured for each event (timestamp with TZ, user id/email, event_type, request_id, affected_resource, ip_address, geo, raw_payload references).
- Retention policy for those events and any default retention windows.
- Export formats supported (CSV/Parquet/NDJSON), compression, and an attested manifest plus checksums for delivered bundles.
- Options for delivery: SFTP with GPG-signed manifest, signed Drive link, or AWS S3 presigned URL.
- Any recommended redaction/hashing approach for PII in the evidence set (we prefer hashed identifiers with salt and a mapping kept offline).

Please include a sample export spanning one week (we suggested 2027-10-18 — 2027-10-24) as an example, plus the manifest/checksums. Also let us know who will be the point of contact on Redwood's side and an estimated delivery date.

Thanks,
Patricia
Senior Audit Manager — NovaMed

--
Note: If some of the events are only available via streaming or live query (not bulk export), please state that and provide the recommended snapshot approach.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Patricia Gomez <audit@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence and export options for SOC 2 audit

Hi Patricia — thanks for the clear checklist. High level answers below; we'll produce the sample and an attested manifest. Marissa and Karthik are looping in as they'll generate the export and the signed delivery.

What Redwood logs (summary):
- auth_event (login_success/login_failure, mfa_challenge)
- admin_role_change (grant/revoke/role_edit)
- api_key_rotation (created/rotated/revoked)
- operator_command (console actions: suspend_instance, rotate_keys, delete_model)
- resource_change (workspace_create/update/delete, model_deploy)
- session (session_start/session_end, session_duration)
- keystore_ops (kms_sign/rotate/disable)
- acl_changes (policy attachments/detachments)

Per-event fields we include by default: timestamp (ISO 8601 with offset), actor_id (internal user id and email when applicable), event_type, request_id, target_resource, change_summary (free text), source_ip, user_agent, region, raw_event_ref (internal id to raw blob).

Retention: default admin activity retention is 18 months (rolling). We can support extended retention on Dedicated/Private plans — let us know if you need a 36-month hold for the audit window.

Export formats and delivery:
- Supported formats: CSV (flattened events), Parquet (columnar, preferred for large volumes), NDJSON (line-delimited JSON).
- Bundles are delivered as tar.gz containing: events.<fmt>, export_manifest.txt (human-readable), manifest_checksums.sha256, delivery_signature.asc (GPG of manifest).
- Delivery modes: SFTP (we can push to your endpoint), signed Drive share, or AWS S3 presigned URL. SFTP with key-pair is our recommended route for large bundles.

PII redaction: we recommend salted SHA256 hashing of user identifiers for delivered exports; raw mapping can be kept offline under a separate chain-of-custody if required. We can also redact email local parts on request.

Snapshot vs streaming: full historic exports are materialized via our snapshot job (consistent point-in-time dump). For very large datasets we provide incremental deltas with sequence numbers and a final snapshot manifest.

Sample & timeline: Marissa will prepare a 1-week sample (2027-10-18 to 2027-10-24) and a draft manifest by 2027-12-01. Final delivery can be scheduled for 2028-01-10 unless you need it sooner.

Point of contact: Soojin Lee (security_compliance lead) and Marissa Cole (evidence ops). Karthik will coordinate the export tooling and manifest signing.

I'll attach a small example CSV and the manifest after Marissa's run.

Best,
Soojin
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: admin_activity_sample_202706-202712.csv, export_manifest_checksums.txt]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <audit@novamed.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence and export options for SOC 2 audit

Looping in with operational details. Quick clarifications before we run the sample export:

1) PII approach — we will produce the sample with salted-hash actor_id (sha256) and include a metadata row describing salt derivation. For the attested bundle we can either omit the salt or provide it under a separate encrypted channel if NovaMed requests mapping for investigators.

2) Timezone normalization — we output timestamps in UTC by default with original offset preserved in raw_event_ref. If you need local TZ normalization we can include an extra column tz_offset.

3) File sizes — the one-week CSV sample should be <150MB for your org sizing; full six-month exports are usually multi-GB and we recommend Parquet.

4) Checksums & attestation — we will produce sha256 checksums for every file and sign the manifest with our release GPG key. If NovaMed requires a corporate signature (executive), we can arrange a secondary signature.

Planned deliverables for the sample package (to be attached to this thread once ready):
- admin_activity_sample_20271018-20271024.csv (flattened)
- export_manifest_checksums.txt (sha256 sums)
- delivery_instructions_sftp.txt (key info)

Estimated sample delivery: 2027-12-01. Full bundle ETA: 2028-01-10 (SFTP push).

Marissa
Evidence Operations — Redwood Inference

[Attachments prepared: admin_activity_sample_202706-202712.csv, sftp_instructions.txt, export_manifest_checksums.txt]

Subject: Re: Activity ledger / admin event evidence — export format & attested manifest request

Thanks Soojin and team — that plan works for us. A couple of final asks before we close scope: 

- Please mark the manifest with the audit period (2027-06-01 — 2027-12-31) and include a checksum line for the entire tar.gz (top-level bundle checksum).
- For the salt mapping: we'll request it only if the SOC auditor needs identity correlation. Please hold the mapping offline and only share via a mutually-signed NDA channel if needed.
- Delivery target confirmed: 2028-01-10 SFTP push with GPG-signed manifest.

Once we have the sample on 2027-12-01 we'll send a short confirmation and any minor changes. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Patricia
Senior Audit Manager — NovaMed
